dialogues.jp: 「はぁぁ……なんもする気が起きんな」
dialogues.en: "Haah... guess it's time to get up..."
dialogues.text: "Haah... guess it's time to get up..."

dialogues.jp: 和久井に活力を奪われた教室で溜め息をつく。
dialogues.en:
I sigh, and try to regain the vitality I lost during Wakui's
lesson.
dialogues.text:
I sigh, and try to regain the vitality I lost during Wakui's
lesson.

dialogues.jp: （ここを動かなければ餓死か……）
dialogues.en: "(If I don't get up, I'd die from starvation...)"
dialogues.text: "(If I don't get up, I'd die from starvation...)"

dialogues.jp:
和久井の授業の後遺症から立ち直れない。だが
お疲れの脳と裏腹に、胃の働きは活発化してき
た。
dialogues.en:
The after-effects of Wakui's lecture left me unable to even
stand. But while my mind was tired, my stomach was active
and demanding.
dialogues.text:
The after-effects of Wakui's lecture left me unable to even
stand. But while my mind was tired, my stomach was active
and demanding.

dialogues.jp: 餓死したくないし、どっか行くか……。
dialogues.en: Where should I go to stave off my hunger...
dialogues.text: Where should I go to stave off my hunger...
